disclaimer: Authorized, read-only assessment of HTTP response headers. This report does not guarantee that the target is secure.
limitations: Follows HTTP redirects by default (additional GET per hop); use --no-redirects for one request. No crawling beyond the redirect chain.
Only five selected response headers are evaluated for presence.
Absence or presence of a header is not a complete security assessment.
Does not inspect HTML, cookies, JavaScript, or server-side logic.
Use only on systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.
